His philosophy, which included the belief in the transmigration of souls, and his work in astronomy, where he calculated the length of the solar year, also marked pivotal moments in ancient philosophical and scientific thought. Pythagoras' influence transcended his own era, laying the groundwork for future mathematicians and philosophers.
